controls.title: Security Management Process
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to prevent, detect, contain, and correct security violations.

controls.title: Risk Analysis
controls.description: Conduct an accurate and thorough assessment of the potential risks and vulnerabilities to ePHI.

controls.title: Risk Management
controls.description: Implement security measures sufficient to reduce risks and vulnerabilities to a reasonable and appropriate level.

controls.title: Sanction Policy
controls.description: Apply appropriate sanctions against workforce members who fail to comply with the security policies.

controls.title: Information System Activity Review
controls.description: Implement procedures to regularly review records of information system activity (audit logs, access reports).

controls.title: Assigned Security Responsibility
controls.description: Identify the security official who is responsible for the development and implementation of policies.

controls.title: Workforce Security
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to ensure all workforce members have appropriate access to ePHI.

controls.title: Authorization and/or Supervision
controls.description: Implement procedures for the authorization and/or supervision of workforce members who work with ePHI.

controls.title: Workforce Clearance Procedure
controls.description: Implement procedures to determine that the access of a workforce member is appropriate.

controls.title: Termination Procedures
controls.description: Implement procedures for terminating access to ePHI when employment ends or when needed.

controls.title: Information Access Management
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures for authorizing access to ePHI consistent with the Privacy Rule.

controls.title: Isolating Health Care Clearinghouse Functions
controls.description: Policies to separate clearinghouse functions from larger organizations.

controls.title: Access Authorization
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures for granting access to ePHI.

controls.title: Access Establishment and Modification
controls.description: Implement policies for establishing and modifying user access.

controls.title: Security Awareness and Training
controls.description: Implement a security awareness and training program for all workforce members.

controls.title: Security Reminders
controls.description: Periodic security updates.

controls.title: Protection from Malicious Software
controls.description: Procedures for guarding against, detecting, and reporting malicious software.

controls.title: Log-in Monitoring
controls.description: Procedures for monitoring log-in attempts and reporting discrepancies.

controls.title: Password Management
controls.description: Procedures for creating, changing, and safeguarding passwords.

controls.title: Security Incident Procedures
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to address security incidents.

controls.title: Response and Reporting
controls.description: Identify and respond to suspected or known security incidents; mitigate harmful effects; document incidents and outcomes.

controls.title: Contingency Plan
controls.description: Establish policies and procedures for responding to an emergency or other occurrence that damages systems.

controls.title: Data Backup Plan
controls.description: Establish and implement procedures to create and maintain retrievable exact copies of ePHI.

controls.title: Disaster Recovery Plan
controls.description: Establish procedures to restore any loss of data.

controls.title: Emergency Mode Operation Plan
controls.description: Establish procedures to enable continuation of critical business processes for protection of ePHI.

controls.title: Testing and Revision Procedures
controls.description: Periodic testing and revision of contingency plans.

controls.title: Applications and Data Criticality Analysis
controls.description: Assess the relative criticality of specific applications and data.

controls.title: Evaluation
controls.description: Perform a periodic technical and nontechnical evaluation.

controls.title: Business Associate Contracts
controls.description: Obtain satisfactory assurances that business associates will appropriately safeguard ePHI.

controls.title: Facility Access Controls
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to limit physical access to electronic information systems.

controls.title: Contingency Operations
controls.description: Establish procedures for facility access during contingency.

controls.title: Facility Security Plan
controls.description: Implement policies to safeguard the facility and equipment.

controls.title: Access Control and Validation Procedures
controls.description: Implement procedures to control and validate a person's access.

controls.title: Maintenance Records
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to document repairs and modifications.

controls.title: Workstation Use
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures specifying functions and physical attributes of the surroundings of workstations.

controls.title: Workstation Security
controls.description: Implement physical safeguards for all workstations that access ePHI.

controls.title: Device and Media Controls
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures that govern the receipt and removal of hardware and electronic media.

controls.title: Disposal
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to address the final disposition of ePHI and hardware.

controls.title: Media Re-use
controls.description: Implement procedures for removal of ePHI from electronic media before re-use.

controls.title: Accountability
controls.description: Maintain a record of the movements of hardware and electronic media.

controls.title: Data Backup and Storage
controls.description: Create a retrievable, exact copy of ePHI before movement.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.description: Implement technical policies and procedures for electronic information systems that maintain ePHI.

controls.title: Unique User Identification
controls.description: Assign a unique name and/or number for identifying and tracking user identity.

controls.title: Emergency Access Procedure
controls.description: Establish procedures for obtaining necessary ePHI during an emergency.

controls.title: Automatic Logoff
controls.description: Implement electronic procedures that terminate an electronic session after a predetermined time of inactivity.

controls.title: Encryption and Decryption
controls.description: Implement a mechanism to encrypt and decrypt ePHI.

controls.title: Audit Controls
controls.description: Implement hardware, software, and/or procedural mechanisms that record and examine activity in information systems.

controls.title: Integrity
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to protect ePHI from improper alteration or destruction.

controls.title: Mechanism to Authenticate ePHI
controls.description: Implement electronic mechanisms to corroborate that ePHI has not been altered or destroyed in an unauthorized manner.

controls.title: Person or Entity Authentication
controls.description: Implement procedures to verify that a person or entity seeking access is the one claimed.

controls.title: Transmission Security
controls.description: Implement technical security measures to guard against unauthorized access to ePHI being transmitted.

controls.title: Integrity Controls
controls.description: Implement security measures to ensure that electronically transmitted ePHI is not improperly modified.

controls.title: Encryption
controls.description: Implement a mechanism to encrypt ePHI whenever deemed appropriate.
